'''Murtog''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of security for the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Darth Nyriss]]. Nyriss was a member of the [[Dark Council]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], and around [[3954 BBY]], she became entangled in a plot to unseat the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. [[3950 BBY|Four years]] later, the conspiracy came to a head with the arrival of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|Exile]] [[Meetra Surik]] to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Another of Nyriss's servants, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] arranged a meeting with Surik, during which Murtog was [[Death/Legends|killed]].
